verdict: Meta went dark this week; lead flow has stopped and is being restored.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads delivered 77 leads at $8.31 per lead — a healthy pace — but that flow came to a complete stop on September 14, when Meta went dark for four consecutive days with zero spend and zero leads. All 77 leads this period came from Meta alone, so when that channel paused, your pipeline paused with it. Restoring Meta spend is the immediate priority and is already in motion. Once ads are back on, you should see lead volume return to the pace the prior weeks established.
